goal: A process configured with [store] backend = postgres and no usable database exits non-zero with an error naming the store misconfiguration, without creating or modifying any sqlite store.

relevant: packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_store_factory.py -- DSN resolution (FLYWHEEL_PG_DSN then DATABASE_URL) and postgres store construction
packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_policy.py -- store backend fields and the distributed-mode guard (read-only reference)

packages/flywheel-orchestrator/src/flywheel_orchestrator/_orchestrate.py -- the worker entry seam where startup preflight must fire before any claim or run activity; module is over 800 lines, use serena symbols
constraints: The failure surfaces at startup, before any run or claim activity; both no-DSN-resolves and server-unreachable produce a non-zero exit whose message names the backend and the DSN sources tried
Under no condition does a postgres-configured process write run or orchestrator state to sqlite (spec D-2)

The new test needs no live postgres: cover the unset-DSN case and a connection-refused DSN (closed local port), asserting exit status, message content, and that the sqlite path was not created or modified
Commit the change (Conventional Commits) before reporting done
non_goals: Do not add retry/backoff availability machinery for postgres outages
Do not change behavior when the backend is sqlite or unset
Do not weaken, delete, or modify existing assertions in the pinned test files
Do not read or write under .flywheel/verification/
edge_cases: Warn-and-continue fallback must fail: after the failed start the repo sqlite path is absent or byte-identical
Mid-run outages keep flowing through the existing infrastructure-failure handling; this task only owns the startup gate
